mapper.insert: INSERT INTO student_member_scores ( submission_id, student_id, score, level, feedback, graded_at ) VALUES ( #{submissionId}, #{studentId}, #{score}, #{level}, #{feedback}, #{gradedAt} )

INSERT INTO student_member_scores ( submission_id, student_id, teacher_name, score, level, feedback, graded_at ) VALUES ( #{submissionId}, #{studentId}, #{teacherName}, #{score}, #{level}, #{feedback}, #{gradedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT sms.id AS memberId, sms.submission_id AS submissionId, sms.student_id AS studentId, s.name AS studentName, sms.score, sms.level, sms.feedback, sms.graded_at AS gradedAt FROM student_member_scores sms LEFT JOIN students s ON s.id = sms.student_id WHERE sms.submission_id = #{submissionId}
